claimBoundary: Source inspection and comparator registration are not performance or product superiority evidence. Formal claims require clean exact revisions, equivalent semantics, independent blocks, and physical devices.

featureCandidates.acceptance: no animation decode while detached, hidden, or fully transparent; deterministic resume; duplicate visibility updates do not restart the driver
featureCandidates.boundary: UIKit tracks window, superview, own hidden and alpha. AppKit additionally uses ancestor hide/unhide. Screen-intersection caching is excluded until a reliable scroll/reentry observer exists.
featureCandidates.name: cached structural presentation visibility

featureCandidates.acceptance: lower physical-device timing error or missed-frame rate without extra offscreen work; benchmark capture must include presentation-target accepted/consumed/superseded/rejected/lifecycle-cleared counters so refresh coalescing is not conflated with timeline dropped frames
featureCandidates.name: display-refresh targetTimestamp adapter
featureCandidates.boundary: UIKit uses targetTimestamp through a monotonic newest-only single-slot buffer and BenchmarkDiagnostics SPI. AppKit macOS 14+ uses NSView.displayLink with the same external-tick core while macOS 12-13 retain automatic deadlines. Package-scoped AppKit controls permit an internal automatic-deadline A/B and common refresh observer without changing ordinary public API. A fixed-six-pair physical-Mac Release study samples both modes on displayLink.timestamp and anchors scoring to the exact driver start; all six pairs favor or tie external scheduling on anchored p95 timing error and skipped source frames, with 14.102375 ms versus 75.461355 ms median p95 and 0 versus 82 total skips. The host actually samples near 60 Hz although maximumFramesPerSecond is 120, so max-FPS missed/early counts are supplemental. No hardware-scanout, energy, thermal, memory, startup, cross-player, physical-iOS or global superiority claim follows.

featureCandidates.acceptance: actual-byte cache cap, deterministic pressure shrink, invalid provider output fails before publication, warning fences pre-warning in-flight publication, no stale publication, measured recovery tail
featureCandidates.name: actual-byte learned and pressure-adaptive upcoming window
featureCandidates.boundary: The first uncached batch remains bounded by the configured frame-count policy; after exact DecodedImage.estimatedByteCost is observed, later windows are capped by the number of equal-or-smaller observed frames that fit the animation cache. This is not a predictive allocator model.

libraries.name: SDWebImage
libraries.w5ObservationBoundary: Encoded-native public SDAnimatedImagePlayer path; source timeline metadata is normalized only for storage-format floating-point representation noise.

libraries.name: PINRemoteImage
libraries.w5ObservationBoundary: Encoded-native public PIN animated-image/view path; source frame identity is recovered from the actually displayed unique fixture pixel because no public frame index exists. Pixel instrumentation is structural-only and never used for energy evidence.

libraries.name: Kingfisher
libraries.w5ObservationBoundary: Encoded-native public AnimatedImageView/frameSource/animator path with display(_:) observation; no independent display link is added.

libraries.name: Gifu
libraries.w5ObservationBoundary: GIFImageView is public but not open. Comparator uses the documented public extension point: a custom UIImageView conforming to GIFAnimatable, holding public Animator(withDelegate:), calling public updateImageIfNeeded() in its own display callback, then decoding source identity from the displayed pixel.

libraries.name: FLAnimatedImage
libraries.w5ObservationBoundary: Comparator-only Objective-C subclass overrides public/standard displayLayer:, calls super, then reads public currentFrame; no private ivar/setter and no independent display link are used.
libraries.w5FreshSimulatorBoundary: The exact same public-API adapter/app can complete 61/60 on a warm Simulator but repeatedly produces count=0 or count=1/progression=0 on fresh dedicated Simulator launches. Public full-cache prewarming and public visibility re-trigger experiments did not make fresh-state playback reproducible and were reverted. Current isolated manifests must preserve this as not-comparable-fresh-simulator-instability rather than retrying until success.

libraries.name: APNGKit
libraries.w5ObservationBoundary: Comparator replaces APNGKit public DrivingTimerType with one behavior-equivalent CADisplayLink timer, calls the original APNGKit action first, then observes the actual layer contents; no second display link or private state is used.

libraries.name: AnimatedImage
libraries.w5SemanticBoundary: 0.2.4 FrameDecimator at maxLevelOfIntegrity=1 retains all indices but returns delays.first as the single AnimatedImageState delay; source variable frame durations are therefore not preserved by the prepared player timeline.

libraries.name: YYImage
libraries.w5SemanticReplayBoundary: YYImage blendFromIndex/lastBlendIndex is used only to derive candidate replay-start semantics. Fovea/ImageCraft adopt a narrower persistent rule; no YYImage runtime dependency or player timing rank follows.

nextComparatorSequence: Do not expand comparator count until production ImageCraft pin or stable-device evidence exposes a specific uncovered lifecycle/format mechanism; SwiftyGif remains a conditional falsifier only.
